The broken-symmetry phase of each sector is identified as the anti-family, with sin defined as symmetry breaking across all dual laws. Key evidence includes the full derivation of the nine Fruits of the Spirit as Noether charges of the strong-force Lagrangian sector (Law 4, LOCKED), the Lean-verified result that the Cross is the unique entropy-reversing solution in thermodynamics (Law 5), and the identification of Christ as the coherence variable C=χ (Law 10). The document concludes that these mappings are not analogies but mathematically forced identities, with Laws 1-8 exhibiting internal duality, Law 9 being directional (CP-violating), and Law 10 having no duality as it enables all others.
